# Jibe/iCIMS employer-owned career hostnames, one per line (# = comment, inline OK).
#
# Every host here was probed on 2026-07-28 from a container with real outbound
# access, through this repository's own internal/httpx client and the Jibe
# adapter itself: GET https://<host>/api/jobs?limit=100&page=1. All 262 answered
# HTTP 200 with at least one posting complete enough for the adapter to yield.
# The number on each line is that board's live totalCount, not an estimate. None
# was dead, none was empty, and no host in this file has ever been observed to
# 404.
#
# "registered" marks a host that is now in JibeCompanies. "alias of X" marks one
# that is deliberately NOT registered because it serves the same board as X.
# That is the finding this file exists to carry: one iCIMS tenant is published
# under many employer domains, /api/jobs has no per-brand filter, and so an alias
# re-downloads the same requisitions under a different company name. It was
# confirmed by content, not by size — for every host, the apply_url list of the
# first five postings was hashed, and hosts sharing a hash serve the same board.
# careers.orkin.com, careers.rollins.com, careers.westernpest.com and ten more
# all hash the same and all report 1,231 postings behind
# orkin-careers-rollins.icims.com.
#
# Size alone is not sufficient and this file records why: careers.mastec.com and
# jobs.mastec.com were measured minutes apart, differed by a single requisition,
# and would have been called distinct boards by any count-based comparison.
#
# 47 alias groups cover 129 of these 262 hosts, so the file describes 180
# distinct boards. Promoting one host per board is worth 38,501 net-new postings
# for 469 page requests per crawl; promoting all of them would have added 26,226
# duplicate postings and 288 wasted requests on top.
#
# To promote a host: confirm it still answers with postings, confirm by content
# hash that it is not an alias of something already registered, then add it to
# JibeCompanies in internal/services/jibe.go. Everything in JibeCompanies that
# contains a dot must also appear in this file; TestJibeRegistersOnlyStagedHosts
# enforces it.
